title: Stained Glass Fox Artist
description: A stylized fox figure composed of grey linework and filled with vibrant geometric shards of teal, magenta, yellow, purple and blue against a black background. The fox is integrated with painter's tools including a lit desk lamp, artist's palette with paint blobs, and scattered map fragments in the upper portion.
prompt: A stylized fox constructed from grey outlines and fragmented geometric panels of teal, magenta, yellow, purple and blue, resembling stained glass. The fox is surrounded by artistic elements including a glowing desk lamp, an artist's palette with colorful paint, and torn map pieces floating in the composition, all set against a solid black background with sharp shard-like divisions.
